title: design_check/1: a design that passed `sample design validate`
description: The answer of `mzlab-cli sample design validate` at exit 0: the SHA-256 of the canonical design and, with `--samples`, the warnings of the engine's `design_validate` route (codes only: fewReplicates, batchNoQc), byte for byte. A design with a bad key or a blocking fault is exit 3 and an error/1 whose `problems` name each key. Code: crates/mzlab-cli/src/design_cmd.rs.
